children.title: Why is Bernoulli just energy conservation?
children.summary: Follows a chunk of fluid: P + ½ρv² + ρgh stays constant (spec below)
children.spec: Chunk: follow a fluid parcel through a pipe that narrows and rises. Work done: pressure pushes it in and out, P₁A₁v₁dt − P₂A₂v₂dt. Energy: that work equals the change in ½mv² + mgh, giving P + ½ρv² + ρgh = constant. Limits: viscosity makes it leak, the PtP caveat.
